Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse LookSettings

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.LookSettings
public final class LookSettings extends Object
How and how often an NPC turns to look at something.

Look tracking is the most expensive optional NPC feature: unlike a skin or a nametag, which are sent once, it produces packets continuously. Every field here exists to let a server owner cap that cost — range() bounds who is considered, updateInterval() bounds how often, and rotationSpeed() trades extra packets for a smoother turn.

Instances are immutable and safe to share across threads.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • range

      public double range()
      Returns the radius in blocks within which players are considered for look tracking.

      Independent of the NPC's view distance on purpose: an NPC may well be visible from 48 blocks away while only turning towards players who come within 8, which is both cheaper and closer to how a person behaves.

      Gibt zurück:
      the radius in blocks, always positive

    • rotationSpeed

      public float rotationSpeed()
      Returns how far the NPC may turn per update, in degrees.
      Gibt zurück:
      the maximum degrees per update, or INSTANT to snap to the target

    • updateInterval

      public int updateInterval()
      Returns how many server ticks pass between look updates.

      One means every tick, which is the smoothest and the most expensive. Two or three is visually indistinguishable for a turning head and costs a half or a third as much.

      Gibt zurück:
      the interval in ticks, at least one

    • headOnly

      public boolean headOnly()
      Returns whether only the head turns, leaving the body facing its stored rotation.
      Gibt zurück:
      true to rotate the head alone

    • isActive

      public boolean isActive()
      Returns whether these settings require per-tick work.

      The tracker uses this to skip NPCs entirely rather than scheduling a task that would find nothing to do.

      Gibt zurück:
      true if the NPC has to be re-evaluated periodically
